block.higgs_audio.workflow: Send text to your configured Higgs server and save complete audio files. No request before execution; server access is off by default.
block.higgs_audio.apply_hint: Changes remain local until Apply. Restart a loaded Run to use new settings.
block.higgs_audio.invalid_number: Check the numeric value and its limits.
block.higgs_audio.invalid_config: Check the Higgs server settings and limits.
block.higgs_audio.model.title: Higgs TTS 3
block.higgs_audio.model.description: Generate complete speech files using your self-hosted Higgs TTS 3 server, with explicit interruption.
block.higgs_audio.help_enabled: Text is sent only when this option is enabled and the text input executes. No request during Run preparation.
block.higgs_audio.help_base_url: Your SGLang-Omni Higgs server, without /v1/audio/speech. HTTPS required except numeric loopback HTTP; no redirects or implicit proxy.
block.higgs_audio.help_api_key_ref: Only the secret reference, never its value. Empty means no authentication. The token is sent solely to the configured server.
block.higgs_audio.help_output_directory: Empty uses this node’s persistent audio directory. Unique filenames; no overwrite or automatic deletion.
block.higgs_audio.help_voice: Default needs no reference clip. Other names must already exist on your server; this block does not upload or clone voices.
block.higgs_audio.help_format: Ogg/Opus 48 kHz or PCM WAV 24 kHz, mono. File output only; not a live audio-stream port.
block.higgs_audio.help_model_id: Must match the Higgs model name or alias on your server. The block cannot verify the remotely loaded weight revision.
block.higgs_audio.help_ca_bundle: Empty uses the operating system trust store. An explicit file replaces that store for this connection; certificate and hostname checks remain enabled.
block.higgs_audio.help_temperature: Official sampling setting. Greater values increase variation, not voice identity.
block.higgs_audio.help_top_k: Maximum candidate tokens kept at each model sampling step.
block.higgs_audio.help_max_new_tokens: A length-limited result is refused, even if audio bytes were returned. Server model/context limits also apply.
block.higgs_audio.help_max_audio_sec: Reject oversized responses; never truncate them into a successful file. This is a local acceptance limit, not a server-side duration setting.
block.higgs_audio.help_max_text_chars: Oversized text is refused before connecting. UTF-8 also has an 8192-byte bound; inline Higgs control tags are preserved.
block.higgs_audio.help_timeout_sec: Includes connection, synthesis, transfer, encoding and publication after dequeue. Closing the connection does not confirm remote GPU cancellation.
block.higgs_audio.help_max_pending: Active Runtime only. Zero refuses new text while busy. Interrupt cancels the local request and discards earlier pending text.
